name: Le Lom Huan
overview:
Nam-ing has always been the picture of grace—raised with love by her adoptive parents and cherished by her adoptive sister, Wayuphak. On the surface, they are the perfect family. But beneath that flawless façade lies a bond that has quietly deepened beyond what Nam-ing ever intended.

Wayuphak has never been shy about how she feels. Her devotion to Nam-ing is unwavering, her affection crossing the line from sisterly to something more profound. And Nam-ing, despite her attempts to resist, finds herself slowly surrendering to feelings she cannot control.

But when Nam-ing’s birth mother reenters her life, everything begins to unravel. With each encounter, Wayuphak’s jealousy intensifies, and Nam-ing’s heart is torn between the family she has now and the past she can no longer ignore.

Adapted from the novel "Enchanted Returning Wind" (เล่ห์ลมหวน) by Flower of Memory (ดอกไม้แห่งความทรงจำ).
